name: Vitriolic Sphere
summary: 20-foot-radius acid burst: Dex save, 10d4 Acid plus 5d4 at the end of its next turn; on a success, half the first only.
text: You point at a spot within range and a glowing ball of acid, 1 foot across, streaks there and bursts in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it takes 10d4 Acid damage, plus another 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half the initial damage and nothing more. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the initial damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 4.
